- memory_id "1001013": As of 2026-01-16, Tomasz is off the Dune team on-call rotation.  (about: Tomasz, Dune team)

- memory_id "1000876": Dashboards and alerts for the image resizer are being repointed as of the 2025-11-26 handover.  (about: image resizer)
- memory_id "1000860": Dashboards and alerts for the event bus are being repointed as of the 2025-11-24 handover.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000849" [constraint]: As of 2025-11-11, the billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 for the peak season.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000791": On 2025-10-15 the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000767": The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000669" [constraint]: The product catalog can be released on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays; the previous Mon-Thu 09:00-17:00 UTC window no longer applies.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000644" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the previous Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC slot is retired.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000346" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000343": The product catalog keeps image metadata in a separate table because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000341" [decision]: The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000328": The image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000325": The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000198" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000155": The indexer relies on the product catalog for product documents, so if the product catalog is down the indexer is down.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
